_comment: Stage lengths, in SECONDS. Edit and start a new run to see the change -- no rebuild needed. Every value is validated and clamped on load (see src/director/pacing.ts), so a typo here degrades to the built-in defaults rather than breaking the game.
_firstStageSeconds: The opening stage, before the director has any metrics to judge.
_baseStageSeconds: What the director asks for on the first shift, before any taper.
_taper: Each successive stage is taperPerShiftSeconds shorter, for taperShifts shifts, then flattens. 30 -> 28 -> 26 ... -> 18.
_bounds: Hard floor and ceiling. Enforced by clampModifiers on EVERY path into a stage, including server overrides and a future LLM director. maxStageSeconds is the real guarantee that no stage runs longer than this, regardless of what the fields above compute.
